skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept of finance and distinguish between finance and money
Analyze financial statements and understand their role in business operations
Apply principles of time value of money to value bonds and stocks
Analyze the capital structure of a company and its impact on financial decisions
Make long-term investment decisions using financial metrics such as NPV, IRR, PI, and PP
Manage short-term assets including cash, receivables, and inventory
Plan and control financial activities within a business
Demonstrate self-reliance when working independently and take responsibility for group work
Apply critical thinking to solve complex financial problems
